noun_data.noun_definition: Report Handling Process is a systematic approach to managing and navigating reports within a software application.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the Report Handling Process is facilitated by allowing users to open specific reports based on transaction items, enabling efficient navigation and interaction with report data.

noun_data.noun_definition: The Report Handling Process is a system or workflow designed to manage and navigate reports within an application.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the logic related to the Report Handling Process (RHP) involves checking if a report is currently open, managing navigation actions based on the report's state, and ensuring that users can return to the report screen without losing their navigation history.

noun_data.noun_definition: The Right Hand Panel is a user interface component that typically displays additional information or options related to the current context in an application.
noun_data.noun_summary: The function checks if the last route in the navigation stack is the Right Hand Panel Navigator; if it is, it determines whether to pop the navigation stack based on the presence of additional routes within the Right Hand Panel.

noun_data.noun_definition: Right Hand Pane is a user interface component that displays additional content or options related to the main screen in a navigation structure.
noun_data.noun_summary: The function checks various navigation states and parameters to determine the appropriate root route for the Right Hand Pane based on the current route, including handling specific back navigation scenarios and mapping to central pane or full screen navigators.

noun_data.noun_definition: The Right Hand Pane Navigator is a user interface component that displays additional content or options on the right side of the application layout.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the logic related to the Right Hand Pane Navigator checks if it is present in the navigation state, and if so, it determines the appropriate routes to display based on the focused route, layout type, and whether the route was opened from the left-hand navigation, ensuring that the necessary navigational structure is maintained.
